title: Require destructive permission for terminal move
goal: Prevent terminal move operations from running under a write-only permission grant when they can relocate or overwrite workspace data.
context: Sources/Terminal/TerminalCore.swift classifies mv as write-only while rm and workspace remove require both write and destructive capabilities. This lets a policy that grants writes but withholds destructive actions approve mv.
forbidden_changes: Do not change mv path resolution or workspace move semantics.
Do not loosen default-deny terminal authorization.
Do not modify App/ or PersonalAgent.xcodeproj.
acceptance_criteria: Terminal mv requests both write and destructive capabilities.
A policy that denies destructive actions rejects mv before the filesystem is mutated.
A regression test confirms the source remains and destination is absent after denial.
verification: Confirm Swift package tests + repository integrity, macOS Xcode iOS arm64 build/unsigned IPA, and validate-contract CI gates.
recovery: Revert the capability classification and regression test together if the Settings policy contract does not distinguish destructive moves.
